name: Corning Inc.
key_signal: GLW has cratered from its 52-week high of $271.78 to $154.61 (down ~43%), with price now 19% below its 50-day SMA and a deeply negative MACD histogram, even as it grew earnings 139% and revenue 20% on the back of AI-optical/fiber demand.
thesis: Corning's fiber/optical connectivity business tied to AI datacenter buildout has driven blowout revenue growth (+20%) and earnings growth (+139%), pushing ROE to 16.7% and expanding operating margins to 15.7% — the fundamental growth story behind the prior 72% 126-day rally is intact, and the stock remains above its 200-day SMA with a golden cross still in effect, suggesting the primary uptrend hasn't technically broken.
bear_case: The stock is in a sharp, high-momentum breakdown — down 12.9% in 21 days and 6.8% in 63 days, trading 19% below its 50-day SMA with MACD histogram at -6.5 and RSI only at 37 (not yet washed out) — while still carrying a stretched valuation (74x trailing, 36x forward earnings, 11.9x book) that priced in perfection after the AI-driven run; annualized 30-day volatility above 110% signals the market is actively repricing growth assumptions downward, and with FCF of just $612M against $16.3B revenue and debt/equity at 80x, any slowdown in hyperscaler capex or fiber demand could trigger further multiple compression before the long-term trend reasserts itself.
